title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Pend Oreille Pavilion, Airway Heights | 2010
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Pend Oreille Pavilion, part of the Northern Quest Resort & Casino in Airway Heights, Washington, USA, on 30 July 2010.

It was the 25th show of the 11th All-Starr Band’s tour of North America, which lasted for 31 dates between June and August 2010.

Starr had previously performed at the Pend Oreille Pavilion on 18 July 2008.

The 11th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Wally Palmar: vocals, guitar, harmonica
  • Rick Derringer: vocals, guitar
  • Edgar Winter: vocals, keyboards, saxophone
  • Gary Wright: vocals, keyboards
  • Richard Page: vocals, bass guitar
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums

  • ‘Honey Don’t’
  • ‘Choose Love’
  • ‘My Girl Sloopy’ (Rick Derringer)
  • ‘Free Ride’ (Edgar Winter)
